heading: String interpolation
text:
### String interpolation [RLOW.6.4]

An interpolated string literal compiles, whole, to one `InterpExpr` node
(`proto/rete_expr.proto#InterpExpr`): a sequence of `FormatPrim`s in source
order. The runtime renders the node in one pass over that sequence, appending
each primitive's text. The compiler must resolve every format spec into the
primitives' fields. No format string reaches the runtime, and the runtime must
carry no code that interprets one.
